cover_letter:
Dear Recruitment Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Enterprise AI Sales Enablement Specialist position at Bradford Jacobs. With over 8 years of experience spanning sales enablement, digital operations, and product strategy within fast-paced global tech ecosystems (such as the Meta Project at Wipro) and startups, I bring a structured, data-driven, and highly collaborative approach to global training programs.

In my most recent role as a Marketing Operations and Sales Enablement Specialist at Wipro, supporting the Meta Project, I was responsible for governing the end-to-end execution of the high-impact Next Level Bootcamp program under strict PMO guidelines. I managed master schedules, defined milestone success criteria, and coordinated operational resource planning. Acting as the strategic bridge between global product lines, quality assurance, and outsourced consultant teams, I ensured all program documentation and timelines aligned with core business objectives. My experience in this role directly matches your requirement for managing global sales training and certification programs.

Furthermore, my background as Co-Founder and Product Lead at Meu Barzin highlights my hands-on capability in artificial intelligence and automation. I architected and implemented product workflows powered by AI using n8n and Supabase databases over a VPS, while managing the project lifecycle from requirements gathering to launch. This experience gives me a deep, technical understanding of Enterprise AI solutions and how to communicate their value to diverse audiences.

I also have a strong analytical track record, partnering with MIS teams to build Power BI and Excel dashboards that measure program adoption and performance, allowing us to generate strategic insights that optimized sales outcomes. Combining this technical and operational background with my certifications (Google Project Management, Meta Certified Media Planning) and advanced human facilitation skills (Thinking Environment), I am well-prepared to coordinate your enablement programs and support vendor and budget administration.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to discussing how my experience can contribute to Bradford Jacobs' success.

Sincerely,
Kevin Augusto Vieira

form_answers.question: How do you coordinate training sessions and manage participant communications across multiple regions and time zones?
form_answers.answer: During my tenure at Wipro (Meta Project), I managed the Next Level Bootcamp program, coordinating training sessions for over 150 Meta Marketing Pros across various regional divisions. I structured a unified learning schedule using automated scheduling tools and shared calendars that accommodated LATAM and Global time zones. I maintained clear, standardized communication templates for invitations, prerequisites, and follow-ups. By defining strict milestone success criteria and documenting processes thoroughly in a centralized repository, participants knew exactly what was expected of them, resulting in high attendance and completion rates.

form_answers.question: Describe your experience with vendor management and budget administration for training initiatives.
form_answers.answer: In my consultancy agency (AK Branding & Web Design) and during operations at Wipro, I controlled project scopes and managed financial budgets for multiple concurrent accounts. My approach to vendor management focuses on building collaborative relationships while establishing clear KPIs and SLA expectations. For training initiatives, I track expenditure metrics closely against budget forecasts using structured spreadsheet models and dashboards. I reconcile training costs, certification vouchers, and vendor invoices regularly to ensure total cost control and eliminate budget slippage.

form_answers.question: How do you measure the business impact and effectiveness of a sales enablement or training program?
form_answers.answer: I believe enablement must be tied to measurable outcomes. In the Meta Project, I partnered with the MIS data team to leverage Power BI and Excel dashboards to track key training metrics: participation rates, certification completions, and post-training sales adoption curves. By correlating training attendance with real sales KPIs and tool usage statistics, we were able to identify knowledge gaps, measure the concrete ROI of our bootcamps, and iterate on training materials to continually optimize sales productivity.
